name: insyte-mcp
description: MCP server that lets Claude query an Insyte Web tenant through the Insyte API (read-only).

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --minify-syntax --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=build/mcpb/server/index.mjs --log-level=warning
scripts.package: npm run bundle && cp mcpb/manifest.json build/mcpb/ && mcpb pack build/mcpb release/insyte-$npm_package_version.mcpb
